scenario.title: 接受、婉拒、提出替代方案
scenario.context: 被邀約時，最難的是說「不」又不傷感情。英文會用 I'd rather… / I'd prefer… 表達偏好，再提出替代方案，讓拒絕聽起來像「換個方式」而不是「不要」。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: We're going to that new club in Xinyi on Saturday. You in?
lines.zh: 我們週六要去信義區那間新夜店，你要來嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Honestly, clubs aren't really my thing. I'd rather do something quieter.
lines.zh: 老實說夜店不太是我的菜，我比較想做點安靜的事。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Fair enough. What about dinner before?
lines.zh: 有道理。那之前一起吃晚餐呢？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Dinner sounds great. Count me in for that.
lines.zh: 晚餐很好，這個算我一份。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Would you prefer Thai or hot pot?
lines.zh: 你比較想吃泰式還是火鍋？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I prefer Thai to hot pot in this heat.
lines.zh: 這麼熱的天，我比較想吃泰式。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Thai it is. I'll book for six.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: A few of us are doing karaoke tonight. Want to come?
lines.zh: 我們幾個今晚要去唱歌，要來嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'd love to, but I'm wiped out. Can I take a rain check?
lines.zh: 很想去，但我累癱了。可以改天嗎？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Of course. How about next Friday?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Next Friday works. I'd rather go when I actually have energy to sing.
lines.zh: 下週五可以。我寧願在真的有力氣唱的時候去。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Ha, deal. What about the hiking trip on Sunday?
lines.zh: 哈，成交。那週日的健行呢？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I think I'll pass on that one. I've already got plans with my family.
lines.zh: 那個我應該就不參加了，我已經跟家人有約。

patterns.en: Can I take a rain check?
I think I'll pass this time.
patterns.zh: 這次我應該就不參加了。

patterns.note: 婉拒時補一句，顯得有溫度

patterns.en: Let me check my schedule and get back to you.
patterns.zh: 我確認一下行程再回覆你。

chinglish.right: I'd love to, but I can't make it.
chinglish.why: 直接說 I don't want to 在英文裡很傷人。先表達善意，再給理由。

chinglish.wrong: I prefer Thai than hot pot.
chinglish.right: I prefer Thai to hot pot. / I'd rather have Thai than hot pot.
chinglish.why: prefer 搭配 to，would rather 才搭配 than。

chinglish.wrong: I would rather to stay home.
chinglish.why: would rather 後面接原形，不加 to。

chinglish.right: Maybe next time! / Let's do it another time.

grammar.title: would rather / prefer A to B
grammar.oneLiner: would rather + 原形（than + 原形）；prefer + 名詞 / V-ing + to + 名詞 / V-ing。
whenToUse: would rather（'d rather）+ 原形：I'd rather stay home.
would rather A than B（兩個都原形）：I'd rather walk than take a taxi.
否定：I'd rather not.（我寧可不要，很好用的婉拒）
prefer A to B（一般偏好）：I prefer tea to coffee. / I prefer walking to driving.
would prefer to V（這一次的偏好）：I'd prefer to meet on Friday.
問對方偏好：Would you rather…? / Would you prefer A or B?
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文「我比較喜歡 A，不喜歡 B」「我寧願 A 也不要 B」，結構很自由。英文 would rather 和 prefer 的搭配詞不一樣（than vs to），後面的動詞形式也不一樣（原形 vs V-ing），台灣人常混用成 prefer A than B 或 would rather to V。

examples.incorrect: I'd rather to stay in tonight.

examples.correct: I'd rather walk than wait for the bus.
examples.note: would rather A than B，兩個都原形。

examples.correct: A: Want to come? B: I'd rather not, thanks.
I prefer working from home to commuting.

quiz.question: I'd rather take the MRT ___ drive.
A: Want to go clubbing? B: I'd rather ___, thanks. (委婉拒絕)
quiz.explanation: I'd rather not = 我寧可不要。

slang.meaning: 改天、延期（婉拒但保留下次）
slang.usage: take a rain check / Can I get a rain check? 源自棒球賽因雨取消時發的補看券。

risk.note: 非常好用的禮貌婉拒，對同事也適用。

examples.en: Can I take a rain check on dinner? Something came up.
examples.zh: 晚餐可以改天嗎？臨時有事。

examples.en: Rain check? I'm swamped this week.
examples.zh: 改天好嗎？我這週忙翻了。

slang.usage: 婉拒提議或食物：I'll pass on dessert. 加 thanks 語氣更好。

risk.note: 單說 I'll pass 有點冷淡，加上 I think… / thanks 會比較柔和。

examples.en: Horror movies? I think I'll pass, thanks.
examples.zh: 恐怖片？我應該就不了，謝謝。

examples.en: I'll pass on the second round. I have work tomorrow.
examples.zh: 第二攤我就不去了，明天要上班。

slang.meaning: 不是我的菜、我不太喜歡
slang.usage: 委婉地說不喜歡某種活動或東西。也可以說 not really my scene。

risk.note: 比 I don't like it 柔和，不會否定對方的喜好。

examples.en: Spicy food's not my thing, but you go ahead.
examples.zh: 我不太吃辣，但你們吃沒關係。

slang.usage: 表示要參加。反義是 count me out。

examples.en: If you need volunteers, count me in.
examples.zh: 如果需要志工，算我一個。

review.question: This restaurant is ___ than the one we went to last week.
I ___ never tried Thai food before I went to Bangkok.
review.explanation: 複習第 32 單元：過去完成式。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: I've been knowing her for years.
review.explanation: 複習第 30 單元：know 不用進行式。

review.question: Sorry I'm late. How long ___ waiting?
review.explanation: 複習第 26 單元：完成進行式問持續多久。

review.question: Sorry I didn't answer. My phone ___.
review.explanation: 複習第 18 單元：My phone was dead。

review.question: A: Want more rice? B: I'm ___, thanks.
review.explanation: 複習第 2 單元：I'm good = 不用了。

review.question: Which is the most polite way to decline?
options: I'd love to, but I can't make it. Rain check?
review.explanation: 先表達善意，再婉拒並保留下次。
